title: BrainDyn: A Sheaf Neural ODE for Forecasting and Generating Brain Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2605.19324v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Brain activity unfolds as coordinated patterns across regions over time, and modeling these dynamics is a central goal in computational neuroscience. Because activity is distributed over connected brain regions, it is naturally represented on a graph whose nodes are brain regions or recording electrodes and whose edges capture relationships between these nodes, with message-passing modeling regional communication. However, standard message-passing networks place every node in a single shared feature space and typically aggregate messages from neighbors by scalar summation, which does not align with neurobiological evidence of brain communication. translated_title: BrainDyn：一种用于预测与生成脑动力学的层束神经常微分方程（Sheaf Neural ODE）模型
translated_abstract: 大脑活动随时间推移在多个脑区之间以协调的模式展开，对这些动力学进行建模是计算神经科学的核心目标之一。由于大脑活动分布在相互连接的脑区之上，它自然可以用图来表示：图的节点为脑区或记录电极，边刻画这些节点之间的关系，并通过消息传递来建模脑区之间的通信。然而，标准消息传递网络将所有节点置于同一个共享特征空间中，并且通常通过标量求和来聚合来自邻居的消息，这与关于大脑通信的神经生物学证据并不相符。为了建模大脑的异质性特征，我们提出了 BrainDyn——一种基于胞腔层束（cellular sheaf）构建的图常微分方程（ODE）网络。该网络带有动态限制映射，这些映射会根据预测的上下文窗口重新计算，而非一次性固定，用以介导脑区之间的通信。
tldr: BrainDyn 提出了一种基于胞腔层束的图神经 ODE 网络，通过根据预测上下文窗口动态重算的限制映射来建模脑区之间异质的通信方式，从而实现对大脑动力学的预测与生成。
en_tdlr: BrainDyn introduces a cellular-sheaf-based graph ODE network with dynamic restriction maps recomputed from the forecasting context window, enabling heterogeneous region-to-region communication modeling for forecasting and generating brain dynamics.
